name: HIS EXCELLENCY XMD 001
description: Professional WhatsApp Bot with auto-session authentication

SESSION_ID.description: REQUIRED: Your WhatsApp session ID. Must begin with 'XMD~'

DATABASE_URL.description: Set automatically when Heroku Postgres is attached; required for persistent WhatsApp session and settings storage on Heroku.

MONGODB_URI.description: OPTIONAL: MongoDB Atlas connection string for persistent cloud storage.

BOT_MODE.description: OPTIONAL: Bot operating mode. Options: public, private, group, solo, sudo, super, buttons, channel. Defaults to 'public'.

OWNER_NUMBER.description: OPTIONAL: Your WhatsApp number with country code (e.g., 254700000000).

APIX_API_KEY.description: OPTIONAL: APIX AI and media API key. Leave blank to use the default fallback key.
